parent_objective: design one calibrated bounded replay smoke over M1487 preflight-pass candidates
blocked_by: bounded replay has not yet been designed for M1487 calibrated preflight-pass candidates
supersedes: preflight-only evidence as outcome-sensitive replay evidence

public_gates: M1489 must design bounded replay only
M1489 must use M1487 selected candidate rows with --candidate-step-column source_step
M1489 must block training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export and actor-input changes
M1489 must require replay result audit immediately after the replay run
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run bounded replay in this design milestone
do not run outcome interventions outside the future replay command
do not treat preflight result as history-positive evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs one calibrated bounded replay smoke over M1487 preflight-pass candidates after branch synthesis
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: bounded replay design only; no replay run, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design uses non-preflighted candidates
stop if design drops candidate_step_column source_step
stop if design admits corpus export or training before replay result audit
stop if design does not require immediate replay audit
fallback_plan: route to bounded replay smoke if design passes
route to branch audit if replay cannot be specified without overfitting
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1488 synthesis admits exactly one calibrated bounded replay design

admission_evidence: M1487 preflight passed with 96 selected rows, 88 neighbor-source rows, 5 seeds, 6 capability pairs, and zero duplicate neighbor viability keys
M1488 synthesis allows exactly one calibrated bounded replay before audit
blocked_shortcuts: do not run replay in this design milestone
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up bounded replay smoke manifest

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1489 is design and makes no history-necessity claim.
history_necessity_tests: future replay must test calibrated neighbor-source rows under normal history, warmup interventions, reset hidden, and zero-current controls
future audit must separate source-diverse history positives from reset/zero-current controls
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1487 preflight and M1488 branch synthesis.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If replay produces no source-diverse history positives, audit and pivot to the L0/L1/L2/L3 go/no-go matrix rather than weakening the claim standard.
allowed_claims: no replay result, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded replay smoke over M1487 preflight-pass calibrated candidates can test whether neighbor viability calibration transfers to outcome-sensitive replay rows.
success_criteria: design blocks training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export and actor-input changes
design routes to bounded replay smoke followed by mandatory audit
failure_criteria: design starts training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change
decision_rule: M1489 passes if it designs bounded replay for M1487 candidates without running replay or training.
